_note: Published per-scene numbers used as external reference points.  Every row is a quote from the paper's own table; MB means the paper's 'Size (MB)' column (10^6 bytes as printed, not MiB).  MipNeRF360 is evaluated at images_4 (1/4 linear resolution) by the 3DGS/Scaffold-GS lineage, which is the same protocol as experiments/*.py --factor 4 on full-resolution ground truth.

_sources.3dgs: Kerbl et al. 2308.04079, per-scene table as reproduced in HAC (2403.14530) supp. Table G
_sources.hac: HAC 2403.14530 supp. Table C, lambda_e = 0.004 (15.26 MB avg)
_sources.pcgs: PCGS 2503.08511 supp. Table IV, lambda_s = 4e-4, 40k iters (12.19 MB avg)
_sources.contextgs: ContextGS 2405.20721 Table 1 low-rate row (12.68 MB avg)
_sources.compgs: CompGS (Niedermayr et al., CVPR 2024, 2401.02436) per-scene table, bicycle row; SSIM/LPIPS not transcribed
_sources.eagles: EAGLES (ECCV 2024, 2312.04564) per-scene table, bicycle row; SSIM/LPIPS not transcribed
_sources.lightgaussian_excluded: LightGaussian (NeurIPS 2024, 2311.17245) reports bicycle PSNR 25.196 but no per-scene file size, so it cannot enter an equal-size comparison
